title: Compact variant mesh and auto-layout fixups for Figma library
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Objective: Reduce combinatorial variant complexity across core components (buttons, inputs, tables, charts) by collapsing redundant variant axes, converting manual frames to Auto Layout, and harmonizing naming/tokens to prepare for a safe publish of ui-kit-v3.4. Scope: - Buttons (primary/secondary/ghost): consolidate size and tone axes into canonical size tokens and 4 interaction states. - Table rows/cells: remove forced padding frames, adopt vertical padding token and row-height token; ensure responsive constraints are set to ‘Fill container’ where appropriate. - Chart legend and tooltip components: merge variant sets that duplicate color/size combinations and extract color tokens. - Tokens: audit spacing aliases that create duplicate tokens and remove 8x alias variants. Goals: a) cut variant count by ~40% in the top 120 components b) eliminate manual nested frames used for spacing c) provide a rename map for teams and a rollback plan for immediate revert if regressions are found
acceptance_criteria: Top-120 components audited and a before/after variant count documented
All affected components use Auto Layout for horizontal/vertical padding and no manual padding frames remain
Naming map and token migration table published to Confluence with migration PR link
Canary publish completed to the Console staging file and no visual regressions reported by SE team within 48 hours
Design QA checklist completed for Buttons, Tables, Charts and merged into the release PR
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Rodriguez: Kickoff: ran a variant analysis plugin and produced initial export (figma-variants-export.csv). Preliminary numbers: 9,600 total variants across the UI kit; top 120 components account for ~5,900 variants. Proposal: reduce by collapsing size axis into canonical XS/S/M/L and normalizing state axis to default/hover/pressed/disabled.
